questions.stem: The number of distinct arrangements of the letters of the word $\text{LEVEL}$ is

options.whyWrong: All five letters were treated as different.
Only one of the two repeated letters was accounted for.
Divided by an extra factor of 2. Only L and E repeat, each twice.

questions.solution:
**Key idea:** $\dfrac{n!}{p!\,q!}$ for repeated letters.

L appears 2 times and E 2 times: $\dfrac{5!}{2!\,2!} = \dfrac{120}{4} =$ **30**
hints: Which letters repeat, and how many times?
